name: Historique des reparations
query:
SELECT r.failure_date AS "Panne:Date:95", r.asset AS "Equipement:Link/Asset:190",
       a.immo_property AS "Bien:Link/Property:140", r.description AS "Intervention::280",
       r.repair_cost AS "Cout XAF:Currency:120", r.completion_date AS "Cloture:Date:95",
       r.repair_status AS "Statut::110",
       CASE WHEN a.warranty_expiry_date >= r.failure_date THEN 'Oui' ELSE 'Non' END AS "Sous garantie::110"
FROM `tabAsset Repair` r LEFT JOIN tabAsset a ON a.name = r.asset
ORDER BY r.failure_date DESC

name: Maintenance des equipements
query:
SELECT m.asset_name AS "Equipement:Link/Asset:190",
       a.immo_property AS "Bien:Link/Property:140",
       t.maintenance_task AS "Tache::250", t.periodicity AS "Periodicite::110",
       t.next_due_date AS "Prochaine echeance:Date:150",
       DATEDIFF(t.next_due_date, CURDATE()) AS "Dans (j):Int:95",
       t.maintenance_status AS "Statut::95"
FROM `tabAsset Maintenance Task` t
JOIN `tabAsset Maintenance` m ON m.name = t.parent
LEFT JOIN tabAsset a ON a.name = m.asset_name
ORDER BY t.next_due_date

name: Equipements par bien
query:
SELECT a.immo_property AS "Bien:Link/Property:150", a.asset_name AS "Equipement::240",
       a.item_code AS "Type:Link/Item:140", a.purchase_date AS "Achat:Date:95",
       a.purchase_amount AS "Valeur XAF:Currency:130",
       a.warranty_expiry_date AS "Fin garantie:Date:110",
       CASE WHEN a.warranty_expiry_date >= CURDATE() THEN 'Sous garantie' ELSE 'Hors garantie' END AS "Garantie::120",
       DATEDIFF(a.warranty_expiry_date, CURDATE()) AS "Jours restants:Int:110",
       a.location AS "Site:Link/Location:150"
FROM tabAsset a ORDER BY a.immo_property, a.asset_name

name: Registre des visiteurs
query:
SELECT v.check_in AS "Entree:Datetime:150", v.visitor_name AS "Visiteur::190",
       v.visiting_property AS "Unite:Link/Property:110", v.host_occupant AS "Hote:Link/Occupant:150",
       v.purpose AS "Motif::170", v.vehicle_plate AS "Vehicule::110",
       v.check_out AS "Sortie:Datetime:150", v.duration_minutes AS "Duree (min):Int:105",
       v.guard_on_duty AS "Agent::130"
FROM `tabVisitor Log` v ORDER BY v.check_in DESC

name: Occupants par unite
query:
SELECT o.property AS "Unite:Link/Property:120",
       COUNT(*) AS "Occupants:Int:95",
       SUM(o.occupant_type='Enfant') AS "Enfants:Int:85",
       GROUP_CONCAT(o.full_name ORDER BY o.occupant_type SEPARATOR ', ') AS "Personnes::420"
FROM tabOccupant o WHERE o.status='Actif' GROUP BY o.property ORDER BY o.property

name: Impayes par locataire
query:
SELECT si.customer AS "Locataire:Link/Customer:210",
       COUNT(*) AS "Factures:Int:90",
       SUM(si.grand_total) AS "Facture XAF:Currency:140",
       SUM(si.outstanding_amount) AS "Impaye XAF:Currency:140",
       MIN(si.due_date) AS "Plus ancienne echeance:Date:170",
       DATEDIFF(CURDATE(), MIN(si.due_date)) AS "Retard (j):Int:110"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si WHERE si.docstatus=1 AND si.outstanding_amount > 0
GROUP BY si.customer ORDER BY SUM(si.outstanding_amount) DESC

name: Historique des paiements
query:
SELECT si.posting_date AS "Date:Date:95",
       si.name AS "Facture:Link/Sales Invoice:165",
       l.property AS "Unite:Link/Property:110",
       si.customer AS "Locataire:Link/Customer:190",
       si.grand_total AS "Montant XAF:Currency:130",
       (si.grand_total - si.outstanding_amount) AS "Regle XAF:Currency:130",
       si.outstanding_amount AS "Solde XAF:Currency:120",
       si.status AS "Statut::100", si.due_date AS "Echeance:Date:95"
FROM `tabSales Invoice` si LEFT JOIN tabLease l ON l.name=si.lease
WHERE si.docstatus=1 ORDER BY si.posting_date DESC, si.name

name: Historique de maintenance
query:
SELECT c.checkup_date AS "Date:Date:100", c.property AS "Bien:Link/Property:150",
       c.area AS "Zone:Link/Checklist Checkup Area:180", c.shift AS "Vacation::90",
       d.checklist_task AS "Tache::250", d.remarks AS "Observation::220"
FROM `tabDaily Checklist` c JOIN `tabDaily Checklist Detail` d ON d.parent=c.name
ORDER BY c.checkup_date DESC, c.property

name: Consommation des compteurs
query:
SELECT mr.reading_date AS "Date:Date:100", mr.meter_type AS "Type:Link/Item:130",
       d.property AS "Bien:Link/Property:140", d.meter_number AS "Compteur:Link/Meter:170",
       d.previous_meter_reading AS "Ancien index:Float:110",
       d.current_meter_reading AS "Nouvel index:Float:110",
       d.reading_difference AS "Consommation:Float:120"
FROM `tabMeter Reading Detail` d JOIN `tabMeter Reading` mr ON mr.name=d.parent
ORDER BY mr.reading_date DESC, d.property

name: Echeances des baux
query:
SELECT l.name AS "Bail:Link/Lease:160", l.property AS "Unite:Link/Property:110",
       l.customer AS "Locataire:Link/Customer:190", l.end_date AS "Fin:Date:100",
       DATEDIFF(l.end_date, CURDATE()) AS "Jours restants:Int:120",
       l.notice_period AS "Preavis (j):Int:100",
       (SELECT SUM(li.amount) FROM `tabLease Item` li WHERE li.parent=l.name) AS "Loyer XAF:Currency:130"
FROM `tabLease` l WHERE l.lease_status='Active' ORDER BY l.end_date

name: Taux d occupation
query:
SELECT COALESCE(parent_property,'Autonome') AS "Immeuble:Link/Property:180",
       COUNT(*) AS "Unites:Int:80",
       SUM(status='On Lease') AS "Louees:Int:80",
       SUM(status='Available') AS "Libres:Int:80",
       ROUND(100*SUM(status='On Lease')/COUNT(*),1) AS "Occupation %%:Float:110",
       SUM(rent) AS "Loyer potentiel XAF:Currency:160",
       SUM(CASE WHEN status='On Lease' THEN rent ELSE 0 END) AS "Loyer effectif XAF:Currency:160"
FROM `tabProperty` WHERE is_group=0 GROUP BY COALESCE(parent_property,'Autonome')

name: Rent Roll Immobilier
query:
SELECT COALESCE(p.parent_property,'Autonome') AS "Immeuble:Link/Property:150",
       l.property AS "Unite:Link/Property:110",
       p.type AS "Type:Link/Unit Type:90",
       p.builtup_area AS "Surface m2:Float:95",
       l.customer AS "Locataire:Link/Customer:200",
       l.start_date AS "Debut:Date:95", l.end_date AS "Fin:Date:95",
       (SELECT SUM(li.amount) FROM `tabLease Item` li WHERE li.parent=l.name) AS "Total mensuel XAF:Currency:140",
       l.security_deposit AS "Caution XAF:Currency:130",
       l.lease_status AS "Statut::90"
FROM `tabLease` l LEFT JOIN `tabProperty` p ON p.name=l.property
ORDER BY COALESCE(p.parent_property,'Autonome'), l.property
